questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
mobility is key and the public transport isn't too afdvanced - maybe share a car you want to travel around, or if youre comfortable - hitchiking is really big. some busses are good to , but just be aware of that. 
do communial dinners  - such a great way to just have a moment together and its that sort of stuff you remember.
camping gear if you can bring or borrow or buy or share - its really handy. a gascooker, sleepingbag, sleepingmat, watercontainer! + watercleaning tabs. (or rent at the gym)
